description: This file is a Java unit test class for the ProviderDAO in the OpenMRS project. It tests methods related to retrieving Provider entities based on Person, roles, and statuses, using JUnit 5 annotations and assertions.

classes.name: ProviderDAOTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for ProviderDAO, extending base context-sensitive test framework.

methods.name: runBeforeEachTest
methods.description: Sets up test data before each test by executing a predefined dataset XML.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldNotReturnRetiredProvidersIfIncludeRetiredFalse
methods.description: Tests that getProvidersByPerson excludes retired providers when includeRetired is false.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldListRetiredProvidersAtTheEnd
methods.description: Ensures that retired providers are listed at the end when includeRetired is true.

methods.name: getProvidersByPerson_shouldReturnAllProvidersIfIncludeRetiredTrue
methods.description: Verifies that all providers, including retired, are returned when includeRetired is true.

methods.name: getProviderRole_shouldReturnTheProviderRoleIfExists
methods.description: Checks that a valid ProviderRole is returned for an existing ID.

methods.name: getProviderRole_shouldReturnNullIfNotExists
methods.description: Checks that null is returned when the ProviderRole ID does not exist.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid_shouldReturnTheProviderRoleIfExists
methods.description: Verifies retrieval of ProviderRole by UUID when it exists.

methods.name: getProviderRoleByUuid_shouldReturnNullIfNotExists
methods.description: Verifies null is returned for a non-existent UUID.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles_shouldGetActiveProvidersByGivenRoles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of active providers by specific roles, excluding retired ones.

methods.name: getProvidersByRoles_shouldGetAllProvidersIncludingRetiredProvidersByGivenRoles
methods.description: Tests retrieval of all providers, including retired, by specific roles.
